description:
Recording palette actions are hidden when media recording is unavailable: the page has no MediaRecorder. To "open the recording palette", every time a step says so: press_key "k" with modifier "Control", wait for the command palette input (".command-palette-input") to be visible, and fill it with "Record audio" (all three, every time). "The palette item X" is the command palette item whose title is exactly X; select it with '.command-palette-item[data-test-title="X"]' (the page keeps that attribute equal to the item's title, so "Record audio" does not match "Record audio and screen"). 
1. Navigate to /new. No [data-testid="voice-button"] may exist (count 0).
2. Open the recording palette. There must be no palette item "Record audio" and no palette item "Record audio and screen" (both counts 0).
